en_title: Minecraft Confirms Ice Caves as Next Game Drop, Adds Frozen Zombies, Ice Balls, and More
cn_title: 《我的世界》将加入冰洞与冰冻僵尸
subtitle: 美丽却危险
opus_summary: Mojang公布《我的世界》下一次内容更新将加入冰洞、冰冻僵尸和冰球。冰洞位于寒冷生物群系地下，包含可用于装饰和照明的冰晶；冰冻僵尸能造成冻结效果并投掷冰球，玩家也可用冰球攻击或酿造新药水。

paragraphs.en: Mojang has teased Minecraft’s next game drop, giving fans a sneak peek at some of its features.
paragraphs.cn: Mojang预告了《我的世界》下一次内容更新，并向玩家展示了其中一些新内容。

paragraphs.en: As revealed at Minecraft LIVE, Ice Caves are coming to the game, adding a new and rare underground extension of cold biomes with glowing ice crystals and environmental variety. Ice Caves include a new hostile mob, the frozen zombie, which can apply freezing effects and throw damaging ice balls. The ice balls can also be used as weapons or to craft potions, adding strategic options for combat scenarios.
paragraphs.cn: 《我的世界》直播活动公布，冰洞即将加入游戏。它是寒冷生物群系下方罕见的新地下区域，既有发光冰晶，也带来多样的环境景观。冰洞中还会出现新的敌对生物冰冻僵尸，它能施加冻结效果，并投掷会造成伤害的冰球。冰球也可用作武器或用于制作药水，为战斗提供更多策略选择。

paragraphs.en: Mojang said Ice Caves add a whole new layer of variety to cold biomes, making exploring underground even more interesting, thanks to the increased environmental diversity. “Though they may be beautiful, these caves are far from safe,” the developer said.
paragraphs.cn: Mojang表示，冰洞为寒冷生物群系增添了全新的多样性，让地下探索更有意思。开发者说：「这些洞穴虽然美丽，却一点也不安全。」

paragraphs.en: Coming soon to the Overworld: Ice caves!
Explore beneath cold biomes to discover ice caves. A rich source for ore full of beauty & unusual dangers, like the frozen zombie variant. Defeat them for ice balls or become frozen yourself!
paragraphs.cn: 深入寒冷生物群系地下，探索冰洞。这里矿产丰富，景色优美，也潜藏着冰冻僵尸这样的特殊危险。击败它们即可获得冰球，否则你自己也可能被冻结！

paragraphs.en: Stay cool & keep an eye out for more updates… pic.twitter.com/fBY6N8UJQV
paragraphs.cn: 保持冷静，留意后续更新……pic.X.com/fBY6N8UJQV

paragraphs.en: Ice crystals can be found in ice caves and can be placed both vertically and horizontally, providing lots of potential for decoration and building. They can even be used as a light source. The Frozen Zombie, meanwhile, applies a stacking freezing effect with its melee attacks. If you take enough hits, you'll freeze. It also throws ice balls at you, which apply knockback and deal damage. Normal zombies can convert into Frozen when exposed to powder snow. Players can already convert Husks into Zombies, and now Zombies into Frozen, opening the door for advanced mob farms.
paragraphs.cn: 冰洞中可以找到冰晶，既能竖着放，也能横着放，可用于装饰和建造，甚至还能充当光源。冰冻僵尸的近战攻击会叠加冻结效果；被击中足够多次，玩家就会被冻结。它还会投掷冰球，造成击退和伤害。普通僵尸接触细雪后也会变成冰冻僵尸。玩家已经可以把尸壳转化成僵尸，如今还能让僵尸变成冰冻僵尸，这为建造更复杂的生物农场提供了可能。

paragraphs.en: Frozen drop ice balls on death, allowing players to use them as well, but they can also be crafted and used to brew a new potion. As a weapon, ice balls deal damage and apply knockback, and as a potion it can freeze players.
paragraphs.cn: 冰冻僵尸死亡时会掉落冰球，玩家也可以使用这些冰球；此外，玩家还能制作冰球并用它酿造一种新药水。冰球作为武器时会造成伤害和击退效果，制成药水后则能冻结玩家。

paragraphs.en: For more, check out everything announced at Minecraft LIVE .
paragraphs.cn: 更多内容请查看《我的世界》直播活动公布的全部消息。
